summary: The meeting discussed the release candidate for Thursday, which is currently blocked by a login timeout bug. Ali will investigate the bug today, and Noor will rerun the full regression suite after the fix. The release remains conditional on the bug fix being small and QA passing. The reporting dashboard redesign is considered optional and not a priority for this release. Token refresh is noted as a hypothesis for the bug, not a confirmed finding. Usman confirmed readiness to support the release once QA signs off.
